banner.title: intel-device-plugin-operator
banner.tagline: Runs Intel's device plugin operator and its GPU plugin, which advertise each node's integrated Xe GPU as gpu.intel.com/xe.

art.about: an operator that turns an integrated GPU into a schedulable resource
art.title: How the Intel GPU plugin is wired

explainer.title: From an operator install to a shared iGPU on every node

steps.title: Operator
steps.text: The intel-device-plugins-operator chart installs the controller and its CRDs. The controller then builds the plugin DaemonSet from a CR.
steps.scene: a package box opening into a controller

steps.title: Select
steps.text: The GPU release creates GpuDevicePlugin xe with allowIDs 0xa7a0, so only the integrated GPU is advertised.
steps.scene: a filter slider set to one chip ID

steps.title: Share
steps.text: sharedDevNum 99 offers 99 shares of gpu.intel.com/xe per node. A pod requests one share.
steps.scene: one GPU chip divided into ninety-nine slots

steps.title: Gate
steps.text: The GPU Kustomization health-checks the CR through healthCheckExprs: desired and ready DaemonSet counts must match.
steps.scene: an eye scanning a row of ready nodes
